status: provisional engineering screens; not human discrimination thresholds

rationale.background_contrast: 3:1 follows WCAG graphical-object guidance where applicable; it is not imposed on filled heatmap cells.
rationale.distance: Oklab .08/.04 and CAM02-UCS 8/4 are conservative provisional mark screens; filled-field adjacent-bin screens are half those values. Distinct spaces have distinct scales. These are not measured JNDs.
rationale.ordering: Monotone lightness per arm is a family requirement; float tolerance covers arithmetic and u8 tolerance covers small export perturbations. Export deviations are still reported.
rationale.contrast_shape: CV .35, step ratio 4, flat extent .03, spike ratio 4 and step size .025 screen broad flats and narrow contrast concentration at the fixed 257-sample grid. They are engineering guardrails motivated by Kovesi, not fitted to the references.
rationale.span_and_center: Spans .4/.3 reserve an ordered lightness range. Center chroma .03 and arm mismatches .04/.2 implement a neutral, balanced diverging design goal; published schemes with other goals can fail.
rationale.features: A 2%-of-range peak-to-trough probe must retain at least 20% of the global-average lightness response. This is a numerical proxy that supplements rendered spatial review.
rationale.arm_separation: At 25%, 50%, 75% and 100% radius, opposite arms must retain .04 Oklab separation; the shared center itself is excluded.
rationale.visual_review: Line and marker sizes are fixed comparison contexts. Rendered inspection is recorded separately and never automatically certified by numerical screens.
